events.name: Holiday Frost
events.description:
Event date: December 11, 2026 
Event Time: 05:00 PM - 08:00 PM
Location: 
2410 Wickham Avenue
Newport News, VA 23607
Description:
Step into the pages of a beloved winter classic with the Polar Express Experience at Holiday Frost on Friday, December 11, 2026, from 5:00 PM to 8:00 PM. This heartwarming community tradition at Downing-Gross Cultural Arts Center invites families to throw on their favorite cozy pajamas, grab their golden tickets, and embark on an unforgettable winter adventure filled with music, festive characters, crafts, steaming hot chocolate, and magical moments with Santa Claus.

events.name: Lights At The Fountain
events.description:
Event dates: December 6, 2026 - January 1, 2027
Event Time: 05:00 PM - 09:00 PM
Location: 
735 Town Center Drive
Newport News, VA 23606
Description:
This strolling, magical experience is filled with holiday lights, decorations and a custom sound and light show designed around City Center at Oyster Point’s five-acre fountain plaza. It also features a stunning 50-foot talking holiday tree named Timber. The 2026 light show plays every half hour, adding even more fun to the season!

events.name: Annual Holiday Tree Lighting Ceremony & Drone Show
events.description:
Event date: December 5, 2026 
Event Time: 06:00 PM - 09:15 PM
Location: 
735 Town Center Drive
Newport News, VA 23606
Description:
The festive season kicks off at City Center at Oyster Point with Annual Tree Lighting Ceremony & Holiday Drone Show on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 6:00 PM to 9:15 PM (Tree Lighting at 6:30 PM). This evening is packed with strolling entertainment, holiday vendors, children's activities, games, food trucks, and the premiere of the 2026 light show featuring Timber the Talking Tree. The night reaches its peak at 9:00 PM when 500 drones light up the sky.

benefits.name: Homeownership Assistance Program
benefits.description: First-time buyers in Newport News may be eligible for up to $5,000 in down payment and closing cost assistance. This program aims to make homeownership more accessible for local residents by providing financial support for those who qualify based on income and residency requirements.

benefits.name: Virginia Senior Tax Relief Program
benefits.description: Property tax exemptions are available for seniors (65+) and individuals with disabilities meeting certain criteria. This state-mandated program provides significant savings for eligible homeowners in Newport News, helping them remain in their homes comfortably.

benefits.name: Cape Henry Memorial
benefits.description: Commemorates the site where English colonists first landed in 1607 and a key location during the Revolutionary War naval battle.

benefits.name: Free Community Wi-Fi Expansion
benefits.description: Newport News has successfully expanded its free community Wi-Fi spots across the downtown area and major city parks. This initiative provides high-speed internet access to help students, remote workers, and families stay connected. Look for the 'NN-Free-Wifi' network in participating public spaces.
